verdict.rationale: The CLI documents an `--environment` option that accepts `production` or `staging`, and staging is meant for a staging account and test data, so agents can work apart from production. The MCP status tool reports the selected environment, and `init --dry-run` previews project changes before writing them. Missing for 10: how to provision a staging account, whether MCP connections can target staging, explicit data-isolation guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration. [2026-10-14 adversarial bias audit (owner-product refresh lane): reverted full 7 -> partial 3 low — all four peers with a documented-but-unverified test surface (anthropic-skills' execution container, codex-plugins' local test marketplace, skills-cli's temp-dir trial, superpowers' worktree isolation) sit at partial 3 low; the owner evidence is a documented `--environment staging` flag value with conceded missing provisioning path, isolation guarantees and corroboration. The owner product as the arena's only full on this story fails the parity check. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
